source: Original PC0x5dfbd0 and its actual sine table; decoder independently checked by geometry-uv-native.py

semantics.mode2: value=f32(previous+frequency*delta); output=f32(value-trunc(value)); negative fractional offsets remain negative.
semantics.otherModes: For an active layer, any other mode, including128, writes zero for that axis.
semantics.gates: Nonmember unchanged. Either disable byte equal1 skips whole material; other nonzero values do not. Layer handle equal-1 skips layer; other values active.
semantics.clock: Globalfloat32 at0x97add0 advances before material evaluation even if no memberships.
